join_constraints: Each fabricated specimen has one current custody holder and an unbroken accepted handoff chain. Design IDs are not individual specimen IDs.
Raw measurements bind specimen, branch, trial, attempt, mount, array and calibration epochs. A changed object, orientation, array member or optical geometry cannot silently retain calibration.
Control and experimental trials require explicit matching rules. A flipped-pattern branch records both orientations and signed transformations; no copied control evidence across mounts.
Source motion requested, source motion observed, acoustic emission requested and emission observed are distinct records. A command timestamp is not the observed event timestamp.
Camera pixels, screen displacement, pendulum angle, specimen displacement and inferred force are separate derived nodes with parent hashes, units, coordinate signs, uncertainty and calibration.
Every cross-device alignment names both clocks, synchronization evidence, residual error and permitted analysis use. Unknown timing prevents dynamic rate/lag claims.
Baseline subtraction keeps both raw parents; filtering, time-window selection and exclusions record policy and reason. No overwriting raw or failed attempts.
Numerical source curves, measured displacement, media illustrations and authored design are separately typed. Numeric design tables cannot be renamed as observed geometry.
Any scientific comparison states source/target conditions, normalization and mismatch; N/m, normalized force, degrees and centimetres cannot be merged without justified transformations.
Paper figures and historical results remain citations, never evaluator hidden ground truth for an allegedly executed experiment.
terminal_rule: Every admitted specimen must end with accepted return or quarantine custody and a recorded condition; no normal completion while occupancy or holder is unknown.
